hook.name: AdaptivePoolPolicyHookV1
hook.description: Applies asymmetric directional LP fee overrides (configurable per swap direction) on Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee pools, enforces configurable minimum and maximum sqrtPrice bounds in afterSwap (reverting out-of-bounds swaps), and optionally charges an additional hook fee on each swap. Liquidity provision is gated to an owner-managed allowlist when public access is disabled.
